scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css

//overrides: Dev-only security overrides for advisories in @wordpress/scripts' transitive tree. Production audit (npm audit --omit=dev) is already clean; these force patched versions of build-tooling deps that process repo/PR content. Every override here is verified to keep `npm ci` lock-sync, lint, and a byte-identical block build green (webpack-dev-server + uuid additionally verified by booting `npm run start`). Regenerate the lock with `npx -y npm@10 install` (see AGENTS.md). fast-uri and ip-address are tree-wide patches — each has exactly one copy in the tree and every consumer range accepts the patch. minimatch uses a version selector so only the vulnerable 3.x copy (markdownlint-cli's `~3.0.5`) is bumped; the 9.x and 10.x copies eslint and webpack tooling require are never forced backwards.
